A \emph{behavior layer} supplies a desired contact-port acceleration $a_k^{\mathrm{id}}=f_θ(e_k,\dot e_k,F_{h,k})$. A \emph{realization layer} converts it into constrained robot commands and reports total desired-versus-realized acceleration error instead of hiding it in saturation. A same-objective unconstrained counterfactual separates regularization from constraint intervention, while plant data expose model error. This paper implements a receding-horizon quadratic program realizing memoryless affine behaviors. Changing the behavior modifies objective coefficients through $(C_θ,G_θ)$ while the robot-command variable and feasible set remain unchanged. A planar study instantiates impedance and admittance; the same running layer accepts an impedance--admittance--impedance reassignment without reconstruction, under its existing rate limit. On a torque-controlled 7-DOF Franka FR3 in MuJoCo, the runtime freezes task-space dynamics per solve and enforces torque feasibility across its horizon. Under a sustained 20~N push, it holds a slack-relaxed workspace boundary to within approximately 0.1--0.2~mm, versus 4.4~cm (impedance) and 4.7~cm (admittance) overshoot from instantaneous clipping. A derated actuator budget then activates the torque constraint: horizon-wide enforcement keeps its frozen-model plan feasible to $2.1\times10^{-4}$~N$\cdot$m, whereas a first-step-only ablation plans up to 11.329~N$\cdot$m beyond budget; on the executed nonlinear plant, where both share the same local-model error, the gap is smaller but still favors horizon-wide enforcement (0.161 vs.\ 0.380~N$\cdot$m). These results are a focused proof of behavior--realization separation.
summary_zh: 物理人机交互软件常将期望行为规范与受限实现耦合在一起；我们将二者作为独立层次处理。**行为层**提供期望的接触端口加速度 $a_k^{\mathrm{id}}=f_θ(e_k,\dot e_k,F_{h,k})$。**实现层**将其转换为受约束的机器人指令，并报告期望与实际加速度的总误差，而非将其隐藏于饱和机制中。一个基于相同目标的无约束反事实设计将正则化与约束干预相分离，同时被控对象数据可揭示模型误差。本文实现了一种采用滚动时域二次规划的方案，用于执行无记忆仿射行为。通过 $(C_θ,G_θ)$ 调整行为可修改目标函数系数，而机器人指令变量与可行域保持不变。一项平面研究实例化了阻抗与导纳模式；同一运行层可在现有速率限制下，无需重构即可接受从阻抗到导纳再到阻抗的重新分配。在 MuJoCo 中基于力矩控制的七自由度 Franka FR3 机器人上，该运行时系统逐次求解冻结任务空间动力学，并在其预测时域内确保力矩可行性。当受到持续 20 N 推力时，该方法将松弛后的工作空间边界误差控制在约 0.1–0.2 mm 范围内，而瞬时截断的阻抗与导纳模式分别产生 4.4 cm 与 4.7 cm 的超调量。在降额执行器预算条件下激活力矩约束后：全时域约束保持使冻结模型计划的可行性误差达 $2.1\times10^{-4}$~N$\cdot$m，而仅首步施加约束的消融实验则产生高达 11.329~N$\cdot$m 的超预算力矩；在实际非线性被控对象上（两者具有相同的局部模型误差），差距虽有所缩小，但仍有利于全时域约束策略（0.161 vs. 0.380~N$\cdot$m）。这些结果集中证明了行为-实现分离架构的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a behavior-realization separation framework for constrained physical human-robot interaction, treating desired-behavior specification and constrained realization as independent layers, and demonstrates its benefits on a simulated Franka FR3 robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种行为-实现分离框架，用于受约束的人机物理交互，将期望行为指定与约束实现视为独立层，并在模拟Franka FR3机器人上展示了其优势。

title: DSG: Dynamic 3D Scene Graph Construction for Embodied Agents in Changing Indoor Environments
summary: In indoor environments, object positions frequently change due to human activities or embodied-agent interactions, causing previously constructed scene graphs to become inconsistent with the current scene. To address this issue, we propose DSG, a dynamic 3D scene graph construction framework that detects object changes and performs spatial relationship reasoning. First, we construct a semantic-aware 3D Gaussian scene representation and develop a dual-view rendering-based object change detection method to enable reliable scene graph node updates. Second, we propose a spatial relationship reasoning method that incorporates multi-granularity visual context, enabling a large language model to identify a richer set of interobject spatial relationships. Furthermore, we introduce DynTHOR, a dynamic indoor scene graph benchmark built on the AI2-THOR simulation platform for evaluating scene graph construction in dynamic environments. Extensive experiments on Dyn-THOR, 3RScan, and real-world scenes demonstrate that DSG consistently outperforms existing methods in both object node construction and spatial relationship reasoning, significantly improving the accuracy of dynamic scene graph construction.
summary_zh: 在室内环境中，物体位置常因人类活动或具身智能体交互而频繁变化，导致预先构建的场景图与当前场景不一致。针对这一问题，我们提出DSG——一种能够检测物体变化并进行空间关系推理的动态三维场景图构建框架。首先，我们构建语义感知的三维高斯场景表示，并开发基于双视角渲染的物体变化检测方法，以实现可靠的场景图节点更新。其次，我们提出融合多粒度视觉上下文的空间关系推理方法，使大语言模型能够识别更丰富的物体间空间关系。此外，我们基于AI2-THOR仿真平台构建了动态室内场景图基准DynTHOR，用于评估动态环境中的场景图构建性能。在Dyn-THOR、3RScan及真实场景上的大量实验表明，DSG在物体节点构建与空间关系推理方面均持续优于现有方法，显著提升了动态场景图构建的准确性。
tldr: DSG introduces a dynamic 3D scene graph framework that detects object changes and infers spatial relationships in changing indoor environments, leveraging a dual-view rendering method and an LLM-based reasoning module for embodied agents.
tldr_zh: DSG 提出了一个动态3D场景图框架，通过双视角渲染物体变化检测和基于大语言模型的空间关系推理，帮助具身智能体在变化的室内环境中更新场景图。

title: CoLT-Drive: Counterfactual Long-Tail Benchmarking and Knowledge-Preserving Adaptation for Driving Affordance Prediction
summary: Long-tail autonomous driving failures are often framed as rare-object recognition errors. We argue that this view is incomplete: the decision-critical question is not only whether a model recognizes an unusual object, but whether it infers how that object changes the ego vehicle's feasible high-level actions. We formalize this problem as decision-level driving affordance prediction, where a model maps a front-view image, ego-motion history, and navigation command to a structured longitudinal--lateral meta-action. To evaluate this capability, we introduce CoLT-Drive, a 3,536-sample counterfactual long-tail benchmark that inserts rare objects into otherwise fixed driving scenes and measures whether models predict acceptable action pairs. To improve deployable small VLMs, we propose KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that combines structured perception-to-decision prompting, SLERP-based expert merging, and RegMoE, a regime-aware LoRA mixture-of-experts module. KPA preserves the pretrained model's open-world knowledge while allocating lightweight adaptation capacity to different driving decision regimes. Experiments on an in-domain driving split and CoLT-Drive show that KPA achieves 60.8\% pair accuracy on CoLT-Drive, outperforming the pretrained Qwen3-VL-2B baseline (50.3\%) and LoRA SFT (32.4\%) while maintaining competitive in-domain accuracy. Our benchmark and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive and https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive.
summary_zh: 长尾自动驾驶故障通常被归因于罕见物体识别错误。我们认为这一观点并不完整：决策关键问题不仅在于模型能否识别异常物体，更在于它能否推断该物体如何改变自车可行的宏观行为。我们将这一问题形式化为决策级驾驶可供性预测任务，模型需将前置摄像头图像、自车运动历史及导航指令映射为结构化的纵向-横向元动作。为评估该能力，我们提出了CoLT-Drive——一个包含3536个样本的反事实长尾基准数据集，通过将罕见物体插入固定驾驶场景，检验模型是否预测出可接受的行动组合。为优化可部署的小型视觉语言模型，我们提出KPA——一种知识保持适配框架，其结合了结构化感知-决策提示、基于SLERP的专家融合，以及RegMoE——一种基于驾驶工况感知的LoRA混合专家模块。KPA在保持预训练模型开放世界知识的同时，为不同驾驶决策工况分配轻量化适配能力。在领域内驾驶测试集和CoLT-Drive上的实验表明，KPA在CoLT-Drive上达到60.8%的行动组合准确率，优于预训练Qwen3-VL-2B基线（50.3%）和LoRA SFT（32.4%），同时保持了相当的领域内精度。我们的基准数据集与代码已发布于https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive 和 https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive。
tldr: This paper introduces CoLT-Drive, a counterfactual long-tail benchmark for driving affordance prediction, and KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that improves small VLMs for this task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CoLT-Drive，一个用于驾驶行为预测的反事实长尾基准，以及KPA，一种保留知识的自适应框架，可提升小型VLM在该任务上的性能。

title: IMPACT: Attention Is the Interaction Map for Scalable Interaction-Aware World Model Training
summary: World models have made remarkable progress in action-conditioned future prediction for embodied agents, yet still struggle to model physically plausible interactions. Existing approaches address this limitation by constraining the generation process with external representations encoding motion, geometry, or semantics. Obtaining these spatiotemporally dense representations typically requires auxiliary estimators or manual annotations, limiting training scalability. We instead revisit the training objective and identify a supervision-allocation mismatch under the globally averaged mean squared error (MSE) denoising objective: prevalent static content dominates the optimization signal, leaving sparse dynamic-object regions critical to interaction generation disproportionately under-supervised. Motivated by this observation, we introduce IMPACT, a scalable Interaction-aware Model training framework with Prior-guided Attention Calibration and Targeting. IMPACT uses cross-attention associated with manipulated-object tokens as an internal spatiotemporal prior for action-conditioned changes. It samples candidate regions from this prior, calibrates them with detached local prediction errors to construct an interaction map, and uses the map to reweight denoising supervision, requiring neither external representations nor inference-time modifications. Extensive experiments on robot-arm and human-hand manipulation, spanning diverse control modalities and DiT backbones, show that IMPACT consistently outperforms the corresponding MSE-trained baselines, improving interaction fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.
summary_zh: 世界模型在具身智能体的动作条件未来预测方面取得了显著进展，但仍难以对物理上合理的交互进行建模。现有方法通过利用编码运动、几何或语义的外部表示来约束生成过程，从而解决这一局限。获得这些时空密集表示通常需要辅助估计器或人工标注，限制了训练的可扩展性。我们转而重新审视训练目标，并发现全局平均均方误差去噪目标下存在监督分配不匹配问题：占据主导的静态内容主导了优化信号，导致对交互生成至关重要的稀疏动态物体区域被不成比例地欠监督。基于这一观察，我们提出IMPACT，一种具有先验引导注意力校准与目标定位的可扩展交互感知模型训练框架。IMPACT利用与被操控物体令牌相关的交叉注意力作为动作条件变化的内部时空先验。它从该先验中采样候选区域，通过分离的局部预测误差对其进行校准以构建交互图，并利用该图重新加权去噪监督，既不需要外部表示，也不需要推理阶段修改。在跨越多控制模态和DiT主干架构的机器人臂与人类手部操控实验上，IMPACT一致优于对应MSE训练的基线，在交互保真度、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均有所提升。
tldr: IMPACT introduces an interaction-aware training framework for world models that reweights denoising supervision using cross-attention maps and local prediction errors, improving interaction fidelity and physical plausibility without external annotations.
tldr_zh: IMPACT 提出了一种交互感知的世界模型训练框架，通过交叉注意力图和局部预测误差重新加权去噪监督，无需外部标注即可提升交互保真度和物理合理性。

title: H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control
summary: We present H3-World, an efficient framework that turns the 33B MiniMax-H3 video generator into an interactive world model. Our key finding is that, as large video generators become more capable, language is emerging as a natural interface for control. MiniMax-H3, for example, already supports zero-shot control of character behavior and camera motion through natural-language instructions. Building on this, H3-World turns this coarse language interface into precise, temporally grounded world control, without introducing dedicated action modules. Specifically, we represent each action as a structured combination of character and camera instructions, and align them with the corresponding temporal video latents. To make the control temporally precise, we further introduce temporal attention routing, which restricts each instruction to its intended time interval and reduces control leakage across actions. Importantly, H3-World directly reuses the semantic representations learned during large-scale video pretraining and requires only lightweight adaptation. With only 8,000 gameplay samples, 10,000 LoRA optimization steps, and 0.199% trainable parameters, H3-World achieves effective character and camera control while preserving strong generation quality. It also generalizes to unseen scenarios. These results show that the control capabilities emerging in large video generators can be efficiently transformed into interactive world control.
summary_zh:
**摘要：**
我们提出 H3-World，一个将 33B MiniMax-H3 视频生成器转化为交互式世界模型的高效框架。我们的核心发现是：随着大型视频生成器能力的增强，语言正成为一种自然的控制接口。以 MiniMax-H3 为例，它已能通过自然语言指令实现零样本的角色行为控制和镜头运动控制。在此基础上，H3-World 将这种粗略的语言接口转化为精确的、具有时间锚定的世界控制，而无需引入专用的动作模块。具体而言，我们将每个动作表示为角色指令与镜头指令的结构化组合，并将其与对应的时间视频潜变量对齐。为了使控制具有时间精确性，我们进一步引入时间注意力路由机制，该机制将每条指令限制在预期的时间区间内，并减少跨动作的控制泄漏。值得注意的是，H3-World 直接复用了大规模视频预训练过程中习得的语义表征，仅需轻量级适应。仅使用 8000 个游戏样本、10000 步 LoRA 优化以及 0.199% 的可训练参数，H3-World 便能在保持强大生成质量的同时，实现有效的角色与镜头控制，并泛化至未见场景。这些结果表明，大型视频生成器中涌现的控制能力可被高效地转化为交互式世界控制。
tldr: H3-World turns a pretrained large video generator into an interactive world model by using natural-language instructions for precise character and camera control, requiring only lightweight adaptation.
tldr_zh: H3-World 将预训练的大规模视频生成器转化为交互式世界模型，通过自然语言指令实现精确的角色和相机控制，且仅需轻量级适配。

title: Streaming4D: Accelerate 4D World Models via Block-wise Video Generation and Incremental Reconstruction
summary: Current 4D generation paradigms are often bottlenecked by a sequential decoupling design: video is generated first, followed by 3D reconstruction, leading to high interaction latency. This limits applications in interactive real-time scenarios. To this end, we propose \textbf{Streaming4D}, a tightly coupled synchronous pipeline that integrates block-wise autoregressive video generation with incremental 3D reconstruction. Unlike traditional frame-by-frame emission and delayed geometry recovery, Streaming4D generates temporal video blocks and immediately triggers reconstruction for each completed block, enabling parallel execution between synthesis and geometric updates. This approach allows the world representation to evolve online with the video stream, reducing feedback latency while preserving geometric fidelity. We instantiate \textbf{Streaming4D} using a Self-Forcing-style autoregressive generator and an incremental reconstruction backend. Experiments show consistent runtime improvements across resolutions on a single RTX 4090 (1.24$\times$ speedup), while maintaining high-quality 4D geometry and multi-view consistency.
summary_zh: 当前的4D生成范式通常受限于顺序解耦设计：先生成视频，再进行3D重建，导致交互延迟较高。这限制了其在交互式实时场景中的应用。为此，我们提出\textbf{Streaming4D}——一种紧密耦合的同步流水线，将分块自回归视频生成与增量式3D重建相结合。不同于传统的逐帧输出与延迟几何恢复，Streaming4D生成时间视频块后立即触发每个已完成块的重建，使合成与几何更新能够并行执行。该方法允许世界表示随视频流在线演化，在降低反馈延迟的同时保持几何保真度。我们采用自强制风格的自回归生成器与增量式重建后端实例化\textbf{Streaming4D}。实验表明，在单块RTX 4090上，该方法在不同分辨率下均实现了持续的运行效率提升（加速比1.24倍），同时保持了高质量的4D几何与多视角一致性。
tldr: Streaming4D proposes a synchronous pipeline that integrates block-wise video generation with incremental 3D reconstruction to reduce latency in 4D world models, achieving real-time interactive performance while maintaining geometric fidelity.
tldr_zh: Streaming4D 提出了一种同步流水线，将逐块视频生成与增量式3D重建相结合，以降低4D世界模型的延迟，在保持几何保真度的同时实现实时交互性能。

title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs as Generalist Vision-Language-Action Agents for Drone Control: Commanding, Approaching, Tracking and Searching
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are strong perceivers of images and video. We ask how far that reach extends into acting: dropping an MLLM directly into a drone's control loop, with its entire action space declared solely in the prompt. Recent systems approach this setting but increasingly narrow the model's decision-making. We widen it back. We introduce DroneCATS-Agent, an architecture where the MLLM is a swappable component, and DroneCATS, a benchmark treating the model as the independent variable. Beyond merely flying toward a pixel, our agent entrusts the model to yaw and search, deliberate when unsure, and self-declare arrival---all without fine-tuning or function-calling schemas. Evaluating frontier and open models across four core capabilities---approaching a visible target, tracking a moving one, searching outside the initial view, and commanding a multi-drone fleet---reveals that even the simplest embodied settings are far from solved. Crucially, to identify what breaks first at the edge, our roster scales down to 2B parameters. The findings expose a stark paradox: it is not the flying that fails. Small open models often navigate into the success radius more reliably than frontier models, yet lose the episode by declaring arrival prematurely or not at all. Multi-drone commanding amplifies this divide, with small models failing by blindly copying a single coordinate across distinct views. Viewed as vision-language-action agents, the models' spatial perception holds up, but their action protocol does not. What separates a deployable edge model from a frontier model is not navigation, but the discipline to sustain a declared protocol and emit the correct terminating action. The open problem is closing this gap at onboard compute costs---yielding a fast model that plans persistently and knows exactly when it is done---and DroneCATS is built to measure that distance.
summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）具备强大的图像与视频感知能力。我们探究这种能力向行动延伸的边界：直接将MLLM植入无人机控制回路，使其全部动作空间仅通过提示词声明。近期已有系统涉足此类场景，但日益压缩模型的决策空间。我们则反其道而行之，拓宽这一空间。我们提出DroneCATS-Agent架构，其中MLLM作为可替换组件，并构建DroneCATS基准测试，将模型视为独立变量。相较于仅向像素点飞行，我们的智能体赋予模型偏航搜索、不确定时审慎推理以及自主宣告抵达的能力——全程无需微调或函数调用模式。通过对四项核心能力（逼近可见目标、追踪移动目标、搜索初始视场外目标、指挥多无人机编队）评估前沿与开源模型发现，即使最简单的具身任务场景也远未得到解决。关键的是，为识别边缘侧首先失效的环节，我们将参数量下限压缩至20亿。研究结果揭示出尖锐悖论：失败根源并非飞行能力。小型开源模型往往能比前沿模型更可靠地飞入成功半径，却因过早宣告抵达或根本不宣告而终止任务回合。多机指挥场景加剧了这一分野：小型模型会盲目将单一坐标复制到不同视角中导致失败。从视觉-语言-动作智能体视角审视，模型的空间感知能力表现稳健，但其动作协议存在缺陷。可部署的边缘模型与前沿模型的本质差异不在于导航能力，而在于遵循声明协议并准确发出终止动作的纪律性。待解决的核心问题在于：如何在机载计算成本约束下弥合这一鸿沟——构建既能持久规划又能精准判定任务完成的快速模型——而DroneCATS正是为度量这个距离而生。
tldr: This paper introduces DroneCATS, a benchmark and DroneCATS-Agent architecture for evaluating Multimodal LLMs as generalist vision-language-action agents controlling drones, revealing that spatial perception holds up but action protocol discipline (declaring arrival, copying coordinates) fails, especially in small models, and that the gap between frontier and edge models is not navigation but sustained protocol adherence.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DroneCATS基准和DroneCATS-Agent架构，用于评估多模态大语言模型作为通用视觉-语言-行动智能体控制无人机的能力，揭示了空间感知尚可但行动协议纪律（如宣布到达、坐标复制）失败，尤其是小模型，且前沿模型与边缘模型的差距不在于导航而在于持续遵守协议。

title: DNC-IMM: Early Lane-Change Intention Recognition via Neural Calibration Based on Driving Context Information
summary: Early recognition of lane-change intention is essential for proactive decision-making in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. This paper proposes a Dual Neural-Calibrated Interacting Multiple Model (DNC-IMM) that improves adaptability to driving context while preserving the probabilistic structure and interpretability of a conventional IMM. The proposed method encodes driving-context information, including target-vehicle motion, gaps to surrounding vehicles, and relative velocities, with a neural network that calibrates both the transition-probability matrix and measurement likelihoods. The final intention is determined from the calibrated IMM mode posterior rather than from a separate direct classifier. Experiments on the highD dataset demonstrate that the proposed method reliably recognizes lane-change intentions before lane crossing and provides particularly strong performance at the earlier 2-3 s prediction horizons.
summary_zh: 早期识别换道意图对于自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统中的前瞻性决策至关重要。本文提出了一种双神经校准交互式多模型（DNC-IMM），该方法在保留传统IMM概率结构与可解释性的同时，增强了对驾驶环境的适应性。该方法通过神经网络对目标车辆运动、与周围车辆的间隙以及相对速度等驾驶环境信息进行编码，从而校准转移概率矩阵和测量似然函数。最终意图由校准后的IMM模式后验概率确定，而非通过独立的直接分类器判定。基于highD数据集的实验表明，所提方法能在车道穿越前可靠识别换道意图，并在2-3秒前的早期预测区间内表现出尤为突出的性能。
tldr: Proposes a Dual Neural-Calibrated Interacting Multiple Model (DNC-IMM) that uses driving context to improve early lane-change intention recognition in autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种双神经校准交互多模型（DNC-IMM），利用驾驶上下文信息提高自动驾驶中早期换道意图识别的准确性。

title: HitMem: Hierarchical Temporal 3D Memory with Multi-Modal Context-Aware Retrieval for Dynamic Environments
summary: Executing long-term tasks in dynamic environments requires embodied agents to maintain robust and adaptive 3D scene representations. However, most existing 3D memory frameworks rely on static world assumptions. When objects are displaced by human activities or unobserved events, agents encounter memory-observation conflicts and often require costly geometric recomputations or inefficient global re-exploration. To address this, we propose HitMem, a hierarchical temporal 3D memory framework with a multi-modal context-aware retrieval mechanism. Through continuous perception, HitMem unifies semantic and spatial information into a lightweight topological graph that captures support relationships, while a temporal decay mechanism dynamically regulates memory activeness to mitigate the impact of stale representations. In addition, the multi-modal context-aware retrieval mechanism defaults to filtering candidates using integrated semantic, spatial, and temporal memory features, and activates a specialized two-stage retrieval process when object displacement is detected. This process combines spatial constraints inferred from external agent trajectories with semantic common sense grounded in class affinities, efficiently identifying high-probability candidate regions. Extensive evaluations on our constructed Dyna-THOR benchmark demonstrate that HitMem significantly improves object relocation accuracy, reduces exploration costs, and enhances task execution performance in dynamic environments.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中执行长期任务需要具身智能体维护稳健且自适应的三维场景表示。然而，现有的大多数三维记忆框架均基于静态世界假设。当物体因人类活动或未观测事件发生位移时，智能体会遭遇记忆-观测冲突，通常需要代价高昂的几何重计算或低效的全局重探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出HitMem——一种具备多模态上下文感知检索机制的分层时序三维记忆框架。通过持续感知，HitMem将语义与空间信息统一为轻量级拓扑图以捕获支撑关系，同时时序衰减机制动态调节记忆活跃度，缓解过时表征带来的影响。此外，多模态上下文感知检索机制默认利用集成的语义、空间与时间记忆特征过滤候选对象，并在检测到物体位移时激活专门的两阶段检索流程。该流程结合从外部智能体轨迹推断的空间约束与基于类别亲和性的语义常识，高效识别高概率候选区域。在我们构建的Dyna-THOR基准上的大量评估表明，HitMem显著提升了动态环境中的物体重定位准确率、降低了探索成本并增强了任务执行性能。
tldr: HitMem proposes a hierarchical temporal 3D memory with multi-modal context-aware retrieval that allows embodied agents to efficiently track and relocate displaced objects in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: HitMem 提出了一种带有层次化时间三维记忆和多模态上下文感知检索的框架，使具身代理能够在动态环境中高效追踪和重新定位被移动的物体。

title: VerNav: Verifier-First Low-Latency Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate through unseen 3D environments according to natural-language instructions. Explicit reasoning can improve instruction understanding and semantic grounding, but autoregressive generation at every step accumulates large decision-stage latency over multi-step navigation. We propose VerNav, a verifier-first framework for low-latency LLM-based VLN. The verifier reduces decision-stage latency by replacing per-step autoregressive generation with batched action verification, while an entropy-based adaptive generator is invoked only for uncertain decisions to produce compact state evidence. To further improve navigation performance with the verifier, we introduce a two-stage alignment scheme: (i) VPO improves local action-preference alignment in static verifier training, and (ii) step-level reinforcement fine-tuning provides dense progress rewards over multi-step navigation rollouts during dynamic task execution. Experiments on the Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmark show that the verifier-only decision path of VerNav achieves competitive navigation performance among representative LLM-based VLN agents while reducing average decision-stage LLM latency per step by more than $10\times$ compared with autoregressive methods.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体根据自然语言指令在未知的三维环境中导航。显式推理能够提升指令理解与语义关联能力，但每一步的自回归生成会在多步导航中累积大量决策阶段延迟。我们提出VerNav——一种面向低延迟大语言模型（LLM）的VLN的验证器优先框架。该验证器通过将每步自回归生成替换为批量化动作验证来降低决策阶段延迟，同时仅在不确定的决策时调用基于熵的适应性生成器，以产生紧凑的状态证据。为利用验证器进一步提升导航性能，我们引入两阶段对齐方案：（i）VPO（验证器偏好优化）在静态验证器训练中改进局部动作偏好对齐，（ii）步骤级强化微调在动态任务执行期间，通过多步导航展开提供密集的进度奖励。在Room-to-Room（R2R）基准上的实验表明，VerNav的纯验证器决策路径在代表性LLM基VLN智能体中取得了具有竞争力的导航性能，同时将每步平均决策阶段LLM延迟降低至自回归方法的十分之一以下。
tldr: VerNav introduces a verifier-first framework for VLN that replaces per-step autoregressive LLM generation with batched action verification, achieving a 10x reduction in decision-stage latency while maintaining competitive navigation performance.
tldr_zh: VerNav 提出了一种验证器优先的视觉与语言导航框架，用批量动作验证替代每步自回归 LLM 生成，在保持竞争力导航性能的同时将决策阶段延迟降低 10 倍以上。

title: A Compact Robotic Finger with 2-DoF MCP Joint Embedding DoF-Selective Passive Continuously Variable Transmission for Wide Force-Speed Operating Range
summary: This letter presents a compact two-degree-of-freedom (DoF) robotic finger with a flexion-selective passive continuously variable transmission (CVT) to achieve a wide force-speed operating range. Inspired by the functional differentiation of the human metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint, the proposed mechanism realizes DoF-specific transmission differentiation by selectively assigning passive CVT to the flexion-extension DoF while preserving direct transmission for abduction-adduction. For a wide force-speed operating range, a force-responsive passive CVT is embedded in the flexion pathway, while direct transmission is preserved for the abduction-adduction pathway. To selectively realize transmission adaptation within a multi-DoF MCP mechanism, an output-side passive CVT employing a moving-pulley-inspired wire-routing structure is introduced. The resultant force generated by the wire tensions acting on the pulley that passively increases the flexion moment arm and transmission ratio according to the applied load without additional actuators, sensors, or control. Experimental results demonstrate a maximum output-force amplification of 4.19-fold and a mean amplification of 3.6-fold across the tested flexion angles ranging from 15 degrees to 75 degrees through moment-arm adaptation, thereby substantially expanding the achievable force-speed operating range. Furthermore, dexterous ball-rolling experiments verify that passive transmission adaptation can be achieved while preserving abduction-adduction functionality. These results demonstrate a scalable transmission design strategy for compact multi-DoF robotic hands.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种紧凑型二自由度（DoF）机器人手指，采用屈曲选择性无级变速器（CVT），以实现宽范围力-速度工作区间。受人类掌指关节（MCP）功能分化的启发，该机构通过选择性地将被动CVT分配给屈伸自由度，同时为内收-外展自由度保留直接传动，从而实现了特定自由度的传动差异化。为实现宽泛的力-速度工作区间，屈曲路径中嵌入了一种力响应式被动CVT，而内收-外展路径则保留直接传动。为在多自由度MCP机构中选择性实现传动自适应，引入了一种基于移动滑轮启发式导线布线结构的输出侧被动CVT。由作用在滑轮上的导线张力产生的合力，能够根据施加的负载被动增加屈曲力臂和传动比，无需额外执行器、传感器或控制。实验结果表明，通过力臂自适应，在15°至75°的测试屈曲角度范围内，最大输出力放大倍数为4.19倍，平均放大倍数为3.6倍，从而显著扩展了可达的力-速度工作区间。此外，灵巧滚球实验验证了在内收-外展功能保持的同时，可实现被动传动自适应。这些成果展示了一种适用于紧凑型多自由度机器人手部设计的可扩展传动策略。
tldr: This paper presents a compact 2-DoF robotic finger with a passive continuously variable transmission (CVT) that adapts its transmission ratio based on applied load, achieving a wide force-speed range without extra actuators or sensors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种紧凑型二自由度机器人手指，采用无源连续可变传动（CVT），根据负载自适应传动比，在无需额外执行器或传感器条件下实现宽力速工作范围。

title: Context-Aware Intelligent Vehicles
summary: Intelligent vehicles increasingly support adaptive applications beyond driving themselves, ranging from context-aware ADAS and automated driving to in-cabin monitoring and fleet management, all under tight requirements on accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability. Meeting these requirements is challenging because vehicles operate in complex, uncertain, and rapidly changing environments while running on resource-constrained computing platforms. This paper argues that context-situational factors that give meaning to sensor signals and constrain decisions-should be treated as a first-class principle for next-generation vehicle systems, and operationalized as a unified, shared state for learning, risk assessment, and closed-loop control across the software stack. We systematically review state-of-the- art (SOTA) context-aware methods spanning (i) environment understanding, (ii) planning and control, (iii) safety and security, and (iv) connected vehicles. Based on a trend analysis of context-aware design, we identify four key technical challenges in building a general contextual engine for future intelligent vehicles: multi-modal context fusion, temporal context modeling, handling rare events, and collaborative context sharing. We hope this survey will motivate the development of robust and efficient context-aware vehicle applications.
summary_zh: 智能车辆正日益支持超越自动驾驶本身的适应性应用，涵盖从情境感知的高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）与自动驾驶，到舱内监控与车队管理，所有这些均需在精度、延迟、成本与可靠性方面满足严格的要求。满足这些要求颇具挑战性，因为车辆运行于复杂、不确定且快速变化的环境中，同时却部署在资源受限的计算平台上。本文主张，那些赋予传感器信号意义并约束决策的情境因素，应被视为下一代车辆系统的首要原则，并通过软件栈将其具体化为一个统一的、共享的状态，用于学习、风险评估与闭环控制。我们系统性地回顾了最先进的情境感知方法，涵盖以下四个方面：（i）环境理解，（ii）规划与控制，（iii）安全与安保，以及（iv）网联车辆。基于对情境感知设计趋势的分析，我们识别出构建未来智能车辆通用情境引擎所面临的四项关键技术挑战：多模态情境融合、时序情境建模、罕见事件处理，以及协作式情境共享。我们希望本综述能推动稳健且高效的情境感知车辆应用的发展。
tldr: This survey argues for treating context as a first-class principle in intelligent vehicles, reviewing methods for environment understanding, planning, safety, and connectivity, and identifying key challenges for a unified contextual engine.
tldr_zh: 该综述主张将上下文作为智能车辆的一等原则，回顾了环境理解、规划控制、安全与连接的方法，并指出了构建统一上下文引擎的关键挑战。

title: AM-Bench: A Modular Simulation Suite and Benchmark for Aerial Manipulation Policy Learning
summary: Standardized benchmarks have played a central role in advancing robot manipulation learning, yet most focus on ground-supported manipulation systems, which limits their applicability to dynamics-critical domains such as aerial manipulation (AM). AM presents distinct system-level challenges, including environmental disturbances, coupled dynamics between the manipulator and floating base, and constrained degrees of freedom. Consequently, task performance depends jointly on robot embodiment, low-level control, and high-level policy design. We introduce AM-Bench, a modular simulation suite and benchmark for multirotor-based AM policy learning. AM-Bench includes representative embodiments spanning underactuated, fully actuated, and overactuated systems, 12 tasks across contact, transport, and constrained interaction, configurable aerodynamic disturbances and actuator saturation, standard low-level controllers, and baseline policy-learning algorithms. Unlike prior manipulation benchmarks that primarily emphasize end-to-end policy performance, AM-Bench enables system-level evaluation of how embodiment, control, disturbances, and policy choices interact. We demonstrate its diagnostic value through three simulation studies spanning high-level policies, policy--control interfaces, and embodiments, together with real-world validation of modeled effects and a hardware test of the learning pipeline.
summary_zh: 标准化基准测试在推动机器人操作学习方面发挥了核心作用，然而大多数基准测试聚焦于地面支撑的操作系统，这限制了其在动态关键领域（如空中操作）中的适用性。空中操作面临着独特的系统级挑战，包括环境扰动、操作器与浮动基座之间的耦合动力学，以及受约束的自由度。因此，任务性能同时依赖于机器人本体、底层控制与高层策略设计的协同作用。我们提出AM-Bench——一个面向多旋翼空中操作策略学习的模块化仿真套件与基准测试平台。AM-Bench包含代表性机器人平台，涵盖欠驱动、全驱动和过驱动系统，涉及接触、运输和约束交互等12项任务，可配置气动扰动与执行器饱和模块，提供标准底层控制器及基线策略学习算法。不同于以往主要强调端到端策略性能的操作基准测试，AM-Bench支持对机器人本体、控制、扰动与策略选择之间交互作用的系统级评估。我们通过三项仿真研究（涵盖高层策略、策略-控制接口及机器人本体）验证了其诊断价值，并结合真实世界中的建模效果验证与学习流程的硬件测试。
tldr: AM-Bench introduces a modular simulation suite and benchmark for aerial manipulation policy learning, enabling system-level evaluation of how embodiment, control, disturbances, and policies interact across 12 tasks and multiple multirotor configurations.
tldr_zh: AM-Bench 提出了一个用于空中操作策略学习的模块化模拟套件和基准测试，支持在多旋翼配置和12项任务中系统级评估本体、控制、干扰与策略的交互。

title: A Wearable Pneumatic Device for Continuous, Closed-Loop, Bidirectional Tactile Interaction
summary:
We present a system of two wearable pneumatic haptic devices that supports continuous, closed-loop, bidirectional tactile interaction at perceptually relevant force and temporal scales. A single device can contain up to twelve pressure sensing channels connected to textile-based pneumatic pouches. Each channel in a device can be used as a sensor, an actuator, or both. As an actuator with integrated sensing, the channel generates stable skin indentation through local closed-loop control. As a sensor, a channel can be mounted (or worn) on any surface, including on a robot gripper or on the human body, and used to measure touch interactions with the environment or a human user. A distributed architecture supports sustained pressure output, rapid dynamic response, and wireless pairing of identical devices in a system to transmit and reproduce tactile pressure signals in real time.
  Device-level characterization demonstrates force bandwidth exceeding 30 Hz, rapid and well-damped step responses, and extended pressure retention compared to prior compact pneumatic platforms. Human studies show that pressure-based fingertip feedback enables discrimination of force and stiffness, improves teleoperated manipulation by reducing applied pressures by up to 23.1% and task duration by up to 27.4%, and lowers subjective mental workload by 18.8%, particularly under visually constrained conditions. By unifying tactile sensing and haptic feedback within a single pneumatic modality, the device provides a practical foundation for bidirectional touch interaction in teleoperation.
summary_zh:
我们提出了一种由两个可穿戴气动触觉装置组成的系统，能够在感知相关的力和时间尺度上支持连续、闭环的双向触觉交互。单个装置最多可容纳十二个压力传感通道，这些通道与基于织物的气动囊相连。装置中的每个通道既可作为传感器，也可作为执行器，或同时兼具两种功能。作为集成传感的执行器，该通道通过局部闭环控制产生稳定的皮肤压痕。作为传感器，该通道可安装（或佩戴）于任何表面，包括机器人夹爪或人体，用于测量与外界环境或人类用户的触觉交互。分布式架构支持持续的压力输出、快速动态响应，以及系统中相同装置间的无线配对，以实时传输和再现触觉压力信号。

装置级特性测试表明，与以往的紧凑型气动平台相比，其力带宽超过30赫兹，阶跃响应快速且阻尼良好，压力保持时间更长。人体实验结果显示，基于手指尖的压力反馈能够实现对力和刚度的区分，在遥操作中使施加压力降低高达23.1%，任务完成时间缩短高达27.4%，并将主观脑力负荷降低18.8%，尤其在视觉受限条件下效果显著。通过将触觉感知与力触觉反馈统一于单一气动模式，该装置为遥操作中的双向触觉交互提供了实用基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a wearable pneumatic haptic device that enables continuous, closed-loop, bidirectional tactile interaction, demonstrating improved teleoperated manipulation performance and reduced workload.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种可穿戴气动触觉设备，支持连续、闭环、双向的触觉交互，实验表明该设备能提升遥操作操纵性能并降低操作者工作负荷。

title: Potential-Guided Particle Steering for Negation-Constrained Dexterous Grasping
summary: Language-driven dexterous grasp models, such as DextER, perform well when instructions specify where to grasp, but we find they fail systematically when an instruction also specifies where not to grasp (e.g., "grasp the handle but avoid the body"). Existing training corpora, DexGYSNet among them, contain virtually no avoidance instructions, and collecting examples for every possible constraint is impractical. Moreover, because every part mentioned during training denotes a contact target, models may interpret a forbidden part as another region to grasp rather than one to avoid. We therefore introduce an inference-time framework for negation-constrained dexterous grasping that requires no negation-specific training examples. Combining Sequential Monte Carlo with classifier-free guidance, our method guides sampling toward the instructed part while pruning candidates headed for the forbidden region, without any negation examples during training. A frozen 3D part-grounding model localizes the forbidden region from the language instruction. To evaluate this setting, we construct NegGrasp, a benchmark of paired positive/negative instructions with constraint-aware metrics that credit a grasp only if it both accomplishes the task and respects the stated constraint. On NegGrasp, our method reduces the violation rate of the strongest baseline from 57.9% to 17.2% while improving both constraint-aware and physical success.
summary_zh: 基于语言的灵巧抓取模型（如DextER）在指令明确指定抓取位置时表现良好，但我们发现当指令同时指定不可抓取位置时（例如"抓取手柄但避开主体"），这些模型会系统性失效。现有训练语料库（包括DexGYSNet）几乎不包含回避指令，且为每种可能的约束收集示例并不现实。此外，由于训练中提及的每个部位均被视为接触目标，模型可能将禁止部位误解为另一个待抓取区域而非需回避区域。为此，我们提出了一种无需专用否定训练示例的推理时框架，用于实现带否定约束的灵巧抓取。该方法结合序贯蒙特卡洛与无分类器引导，在训练阶段无需任何否定示例即可将采样导向指定部位，同时剪除朝向禁止区域的候选方案。通过冻结的3D部件定位模型，我们从语言指令中定位禁止区域。为评估该场景，我们构建了NegGrasp基准数据集，包含成对的正/否定指令及约束感知指标——仅当抓取动作既完成任务又满足规定约束时才判定为有效。在NegGrasp上，我们的方法将最强基线的违反率从57.9%降至17.2%，同时提升了约束感知成功率与物理成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces an inference-time framework using Sequential Monte Carlo and classifier-free guidance to enforce negation constraints (e.g., 'avoid the body') in dexterous grasping without requiring negation-specific training data, and presents a benchmark NegGrasp for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于顺序蒙特卡洛和无分类器指导的推理阶段框架，无需负例训练数据即可在灵巧抓取中强制执行否定约束（例如“避免抓取瓶身”），并构建了基准数据集NegGrasp用于评估。

title: Exploring Nonlinear Body Oscillations for Natural Quadruped Gaits
summary: Animals' body morphology shapes the gait patterns they can perform, where mechanical resonance reduces the need for active control. By tuning posture and muscle stiffness, they leverage their embodied intelligence to achieve effective gaits for different speeds. In contrast, most quadruped robots are not specifically designed to exploit mechanical resonance due to the complexity of nonlinear dynamics and require dedicated locomotion controllers. To provide an alternative, we present a proof of concept framework making the nonlinear dynamics of a robot predictable in the design process and show how this knowledge can be leveraged such that multi-gait locomotion can emerge from nonlinear resonances, shaped by gravity, inertia, and elasticity. We present the highly compliant quadruped robot eBert, on which we identify six nonlinear normal modes (NNMs) using our new theoretical tools and validate their existence in simulation and hardware. With black-box optimization to determine step length, simulations show how each NNM naturally develops into a distinct gait, manifesting different speeds, which also largely transfers to the robotic hardware. Our experiments show that eBert can exploit its mechanics to generate task-specific movements which may serve as foundation for designing a new generation of agile and efficient robots leveraging embodied intelligence.
summary_zh: 动物的身体形态决定了其所能执行的步态模式，其中机械共振减少了对主动控制的需求。通过调整姿态和肌肉刚度，动物利用其具身智能实现不同速度下的有效步态。相比之下，大多数四足机器人由于非线性动力学的复杂性，并未专门设计利用机械共振，且需要专用的运动控制器。为提供替代方案，我们提出了一种概念验证框架，使机器人的非线性动力学在设计过程中变得可预测，并展示如何利用这一知识，使多步态运动能够从由重力、惯性和弹性塑造的非线性共振中涌现。我们介绍了一种高柔顺性四足机器人eBert，利用新理论工具在其上识别出六种非线性正则模态（NNMs），并通过仿真和硬件验证了其存在性。通过黑箱优化确定步长，仿真表明每种NNM自然演变为具有不同速度的独特步态，且这一特性在很大程度上迁移至机器人硬件。我们的实验表明，eBert能够利用其力学特性生成特定任务的动作，这有望为设计新一代利用具身智能的敏捷高效机器人奠定基础。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for designing quadruped robots that exploit nonlinear body oscillations to generate natural gaits, demonstrating on the compliant robot eBert that nonlinear normal modes can produce distinct gaits with different speeds via black-box optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种框架，通过利用非线性身体振荡设计四足机器人，使其产生自然步态，并在柔性机器人eBert上证明非线性正常模态可通过黑箱优化生成不同速度的独特步态。

title: Scene Graph-based Driving Scenario Extraction for Automotive Egocentric Datasets
summary: Extracting scenarios from unlabelled real-world sensor data streams is a critical but challenging task in the development process of automated driving systems (ADS). Automatically sifting through large datasets to spatially and temporally locate critical scenarios can enable scenario-based coverage analysis of ADS datasets. In this paper, we present a method for extracting scenarios from egocentric datasets using scene graphs and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL). We first process egocentric sensor data and HD maps to generate a sequence of scene graphs representing a driving scenario. Next, we use LTL to formally specify driving scenarios of interest, then extract all instances of the scenarios from the dataset using an off-the-shelf model checker, which evaluates the LTL formula against the sequence of scene graphs. Our approach can be used on both simulated and real world datasets. We evaluate the method on the training and validation datasets from Argoverse 2 consisting of 850 15-second real-world driving logs, and several videos of dashcam footage. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for extracting and querying scenarios by evaluating against a rule-based benchmark based on track annotations and HD maps.
summary_zh: 从无标签真实世界传感器数据流中提取场景是自动驾驶系统（ADS）开发过程中一项关键但具有挑战性的任务。自动筛选大规模数据集以在空间和时间上定位关键场景，可实现对ADS数据集进行基于场景的覆盖分析。本文提出一种利用场景图与线性时序逻辑（LTL）从自我中心数据集中提取场景的方法。我们首先处理自我中心传感器数据和高精度地图，生成表示驾驶场景的场景图序列；随后采用LTL对感兴趣的驾驶场景进行形式化规约，并通过现成的模型检验器对场景图序列进行LTL公式评估，从而从数据集中提取所有符合该场景的实例。该方法可同时应用于仿真与真实世界数据集。我们基于Argoverse 2的训练与验证数据集（包含850条15秒真实驾驶记录及多段行车记录仪视频）进行方法评估，并通过与基于轨迹标注和高精度地图的规则基准进行对比，验证了本方法在场景提取与查询中的有效性。
tldr: A method using scene graphs and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) to automatically extract driving scenarios from egocentric automotive datasets, evaluated on Argoverse 2 and dashcam footage.
tldr_zh: 一种利用场景图和线性时序逻辑(LTL)从自车视角汽车数据集中自动提取驾驶场景的方法，在Argoverse 2和行车记录仪视频上进行了评估。

title: Beyond Textual Chain-of-Thought: A Survey on Action-Grounded Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning powers generative models by eliciting intermediate steps before producing an answer. In autonomous driving, the answer is a continuous action. Thus its reasoning must share the same spatiotemporal structure as the physical world. This survey studies the resulting shift from textual CoT to action-grounded reasoning. Surveying 171 papers, including 130 method papers and 41 benchmarks, datasets, surveys, and analysis papers, we propose a representation-centered taxonomy that treats the form of the intermediate state as the organizing axis. We systematize the 130 methods into four categories: language-based, visual-spatial, latent-dynamic, and externalized reasoning, further divided into 13 subtypes tied to distinct regions of interests. Our synthesis shows that the open frontier of reasoning in driving agents lies in intermediate representations that can be grounded in the real world, coupled to real-time action, and verified under safety-critical systems. Project page: https://github.com/tangzhengxu/awesome-av-cot.
summary_zh: 思维链（Chain-of-thought, CoT）推理通过引导生成模型在产生最终答案前输出中间步骤来增强其能力。在自动驾驶领域，最终答案表现为连续动作。因此，其推理过程必须与物理世界保持相同的时空结构。本综述研究了从文本型CoT向基于行动（action-grounded）推理的范式转变。我们调研了171篇论文（包括130篇方法论文及41篇基准、数据集、综述与分析论文），提出了一种以表征为中心的分类法，将中间状态的形式作为组织主轴。我们将130种方法系统化为四大类别：基于语言推理、视觉空间推理、潜在动态推理与外部化推理，并进一步细分为与不同关注区域相关联的13种子类型。综合研究表明：驾驶智能体推理的前沿开放领域在于构建能够扎根现实世界、耦合实时行动并在安全关键系统下可验证的中间表征。项目主页：https://github.com/tangzhengxu/awesome-av-cot
tldr: This survey systematically reviews 171 papers on action-grounded reasoning for autonomous driving, proposing a taxonomy that categorizes methods into language-based, visual-spatial, latent-dynamic, and externalized reasoning, and identifies the open frontier as grounded intermediate representations coupled to real-time action under safety-critical constraints.
tldr_zh: 本综述系统性地回顾了171篇关于自动驾驶中基于行动推理的论文，提出了一种分类法，将方法分为基于语言、视觉空间、潜在动态和外部化推理四类，并指出开放前沿在于能与现实世界结合、实时行动且可在安全关键系统中验证的中间表示。

title: Towards Generalizable Visually Grounded Exploration of Household Devices
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in static visual recognition and high-level semantic reasoning. However, current embodied exploration paradigms still heavily rely on imitation learning from human-annotated trajectories, which severely limits agents' generalization ability. The key bottleneck of realizing general autonomous embodied agents lies in Generalizable Visually Grounded Exploration: the ability to operate novel devices without manuals or specific training by actively grounding abstract world knowledge into fine-grained visual affordances. Yet, existing benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability: they generally rely on explicit documents and annotated trajectories, neglecting the dynamic Hypothesis-Interaction-Refinement process essential for functional device operation. To bridge this gap, we introduce VGEBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the generalizable visually grounded exploration capabilities of VLMs. Unlike static datasets, we construct a Logic-Driven State Machine framework. This framework simulates multi-turn interaction loops, compelling agents to achieve goals by active visual perception and feedback-driven correction. Experimental results demonstrate that existing VLMs face significant challenges in translating semantic knowledge into physical execution and maintaining long-horizon state tracking.
summary_zh: 近期，视觉-语言模型在静态视觉识别与高层语义推理方面取得了显著进展。然而，当前的具身探索范式仍高度依赖人工标注轨迹的模仿学习，这严重制约了智能体的泛化能力。实现通用自主具身智能体的关键瓶颈在于可泛化的视觉锚定探索：即通过将抽象世界知识主动锚定至细粒度视觉可供性，在无需手册或特定训练的情况下操作新型设备的能力。然而，现有基准无法评估这一能力——它们通常依赖显式文档与标注轨迹，忽视了功能性设备操作中至关重要的"假设-交互-修正"动态过程。为填补这一空白，我们提出VGEBench——一个专为评估视觉-语言模型可泛化视觉锚定探索能力而设计的综合性基准。与静态数据集不同，我们构建了逻辑驱动状态机框架，该框架模拟多轮交互循环，迫使智能体通过主动视觉感知与反馈驱动修正达成目标。实验结果表明，现有视觉-语言模型在将语义知识转化为物理执行以及维持长程状态追踪方面面临显著挑战。
tldr: Introduces VGEBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on generalizable visually grounded exploration of household devices through a Logic-Driven State Machine framework that simulates hypothesis-interaction-refinement loops.
tldr_zh: 提出了VGEBench基准，通过逻辑驱动状态机框架模拟假设-交互-精化循环，评估VLM在家用设备上的泛化视觉基础探索能力。

title: Autonomous robotic bridging using distributed swarm control without inter-agent communication
summary: We describe SCARAB--Swarm-Capable Autonomous Robotic Aquatic Bridging. Using distributed swarm control and multi-model sensing of agents and docking targets, agents can localize themselves, join into formations and proceed to desired target locations. Our technologies would eventually allow the Army to perform unpredictable, dispersed river crossings, enhance crew survivability, and minimize the logistics footprint compared to the current Improved Ribbon Bridge. Our methods operate without GPS or RF communications, though these can be used in non-contested environments (e.g., civilian disaster relief for flooding, etc.). We demonstrate our system via physics-engine-based simulation of several agents using unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) in the presence of currents and wind.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了SCARAB——具备蜂群能力的自主机器人水上架桥系统。通过分布式蜂群控制以及针对智能体和对接目标的多模态感知，智能体能够实现自身定位、编队组合并前往指定目标位置。与现有的改进型带式浮桥相比，我们的技术最终将使陆军能够执行不可预测的分散渡河任务，提高乘员生存能力，并最大限度减少后勤保障规模。该方法无需依赖GPS或射频通信即可运行（尽管在非对抗环境下仍可使用这些手段，例如民用洪涝灾害救援等）。我们通过基于物理引擎的仿真，在存在水流和风力的条件下，利用多艘无人水面艇（USV）展示了该系统。
tldr: A distributed swarm control system for autonomous robotic bridging using multi-modal sensing and no inter-agent communication, demonstrated in simulation with USVs.
tldr_zh: 一种无需智能体间通信的分布式集群控制自主机器人架桥系统，通过多模态感知实现，并在无人水面艇仿真中验证。

title: Scalable Rao-Blackwellized Online Planning for High-Dimensional POMDPs
summary: Online planning under uncertainty remains a fundamental challenge for robotic systems operating in partially observable environments with high-dimensional state spaces. While sampling-based POMDP solvers enable approximate decision-making in large or continuous domains, their performance degrades as belief dimensionality increases due to the high variance inherent in Monte Carlo-based estimation. In this work, we extend the Rao-Blackwellized online POMDP (RB-POMDP) framework to improve its generalizability in high-dimensional settings through hybrid continuous-discrete belief representations. By analytically propagating uncertainty associated with marginalized state components during tree-based planning, the proposed approach reduces sampling-induced variance in value estimation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this framework in a robotic search-and-rescue task by integrating it with FastSLAM 2.0. Experimental results show that the proposed planner achieves higher cumulative rewards using significantly fewer particles and planning simulations than purely sampling-based methods under equivalent computational budgets. These results suggest that structured high-dimensional robotic problems admitting tractable sufficient statistics can be effectively leveraged within the RB-POMDP framework for computationally feasible online decision-making.
summary_zh: 不确定性环境下的在线规划仍是机器人在高维状态空间部分可观测环境中运行所面临的根本性挑战。尽管基于采样的POMDP求解器能够在大规模或连续域中实现近似决策，但由于基于蒙特卡洛估计固有的高方差特性，其性能会随信念维度的增加而下降。本研究通过引入混合连续-离散信念表征，对Rao-Blackwellized在线POMDP（RB-POMDP）框架进行扩展，以提升其在高维场景中的泛化能力。所提方法在基于树的规划过程中，通过解析传播与边缘化状态分量相关的不确定性，降低了价值估计中的采样诱发方差。通过将所提框架与FastSLAM 2.0集成，我们在机器人搜救任务中验证了其有效性。实验结果表明，在同等计算预算下，相较于纯采样方法，所提规划器能以显著更少的粒子和规划模拟获得更高的累计奖励。这些结果表明，具备可处理充分统计量的结构化高维机器人问题，能够被有效纳入RB-POMDP框架中，从而实现计算可行的在线决策。
tldr: This paper extends the Rao-Blackwellized POMDP framework with hybrid continuous-discrete belief representations to reduce sampling variance in high-dimensional online planning, validated on a robotic search-and-rescue task integrated with FastSLAM 2.0.
tldr_zh: 本文通过混合连续-离散信念表示扩展了Rao-Blackwellized POMDP框架，降低了高维在线规划中的采样方差，并在集成FastSLAM 2.0的机器人搜索与救援任务中进行了验证。

title: Adaptive Depth-Map-Guided Bundle Adjustment for Correspondence-Free Multi-View Point Cloud Registration
summary: Robotic processing of irregular steel scrap requires dense 3-D measurement to replace manual visual assessment in hazardous cutting workcells. The reconstructed map is used to estimate piece dimensions, boundary geometry, feasible preheating and cutting regions, and collision-aware torch paths. The reconstruction errors therefore propagate directly to downstream measurement and planning. Existing multi-view registration methods commonly rely on feature extraction and data association to establish correspondences between views. In workcells with smooth metallic surfaces, repeated structures, occlusions, and partial overlaps, however, wrong correspondences may be established, leading to inaccurate pose estimation and distorted reconstruction. This paper presents an adaptive layered depth-map-guided bundle adjustment framework for correspondence-free multi-view point cloud registration. The scene is represented by a global 2.5-D grid, where each cell can adaptively maintain multiple depth hypotheses. Raw depth observations are directly projected into the global map to form depth constraints without explicit feature correspondences. At grid cells where multiple surfaces produce conflicting depths, a softmax-based layer assignment links each observation to compatible depth hypotheses. The resulting nonlinear least-squares formulation jointly refines sensor poses and the layered depth map, with correspondences implicitly induced by the depth-map representation and projection model. Experiments on self-collected industrial datasets show that the proposed method achieves consistently competitive reconstruction accuracy while maintaining robustness and low computational cost in challenging industrial scenarios. We release the open-source code implementation at: https://github.com/YiranZhou-Robotics/ADM-BA.git
summary_zh:
摘要：  
不规则废钢的机器人加工需要高密度三维测量，以替代危险切割作业单元中的人工目视评估。重建地图用于估算工件尺寸、边界几何形状、可行的预热与切割区域，以及考虑碰撞的焊炬路径。因此，重建误差会直接传递至下游的测量与规划环节。现有的多视图配准方法通常依赖特征提取与数据关联来建立视图之间的对应关系。然而，在具有光滑金属表面、重复结构、遮挡及部分重叠的作业单元中，可能建立错误的对应关系，导致位姿估计不准确及重建失真。本文提出一种自适应分层深度图引导的集束调整框架，用于无对应点的多视图点云配准。场景由全局2.5维网格表示，每个单元可自适应地维护多个深度假设。原始深度观测直接投影至全局地图以形成深度约束，无需显式特征对应。在多个表面产生深度冲突的网格单元中，基于softmax的层分配将每个观测关联至兼容的深度假设。最终的非线性最小二乘公式联合优化传感器位姿与分层深度图，对应关系由深度图表示与投影模型隐式生成。在自采工业数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在保持鲁棒性与低计算成本的同时，在挑战性工业场景中实现了持续具有竞争力的重建精度。我们已将开源代码实现发布于：https://github.com/YiranZhou-Robotics/ADM-BA.git
tldr: An adaptive depth-map-guided bundle adjustment method for correspondence-free multi-view point cloud registration, targeting 3D reconstruction of metallic scrap surfaces for robotic cutting workcells.
tldr_zh: 一种自适应深度图引导的捆绑调整方法，用于无需对应点的多视角点云配准，针对金属废料表面的三维重建，以应用于机器人切割工作站。

title: Importance and methods to control, vary, and characterize mud strength for studying locomotion
summary: Animals and robots encounter mud at the water-land interface. Like sand, mud can stay solid or flow like a fluid. Unlike sand, the yield strength of mud at which solid-fluid transitions occur depends on not only the amount of solid relative to fluid (water in mud, air in dry sand), but also how much coarse grains and fine clay are within the solid. Despite understanding of locomotion on/within dry sand dominated by coarse grains with repulsive normal forces and friction, little is known for mud dominated by fine clay with strong cohesion. Here, we developed methods to prepare uniform mud of controlled, variable yield strength and characterize and track its drift from water evaporation. Compared to other flowable substrates, mud strength measured by upward force during penetration is weaker and can vary more, and mud sticks more during extraction to pull downward, making it more challenging for locomotion.
summary_zh:
摘要：  
动物与机器人在水陆交界处经常会遇到泥泞环境。与沙土类似，泥浆既可以保持固态，也可以像流体一样流动。但与沙土不同的是，泥浆发生固-液转变时的屈服强度不仅取决于固相与液相（泥浆中的水、干沙中的空气）的相对含量，还取决于固相中粗颗粒与细黏土的比例。尽管目前对以粗颗粒为主、具有斥性法向力和摩擦特性的干沙环境中的运动机制已有较为深入的理解，但对于以强黏性细黏土为主的泥浆环境，其运动机理尚不清楚。为此，我们开发了制备均匀泥浆的方法，可控制其屈服强度并实现可变调节，同时能够表征并追踪因水分蒸发引起的泥浆漂移。与其他可流动介质相比，泥浆在贯入过程中所测得的向上抗力更弱且变化幅度更大，且在拔出过程中黏附力更强，产生向下拉力，因而使得运动更加困难。
tldr: This paper presents methods for preparing and characterizing mud with controlled yield strength to study locomotion, addressing the gap in understanding cohesive substrates compared to dry sand.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了制备和表征具有可控屈服强度的泥浆的方法，以研究运动机制，填补了与干沙相比对粘性基底理解的空白。

title: Not All Agreement Counts as Corroboration: Provenance-Conserving Multi-View Fusion for Typed Action Admission in Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: For embodied systems, predictive agreement alone does not determine whether evidence warrants action; evidential origin matters. Repeated inference over one observation can multiply agreement without adding evidence, while source-local values do not reveal whether outputs have separately countable origins. PACT treats evidence countability as a relational variable for provenance-conserving fusion and typed action admission. A supplied provenance partition defines countable units. PACT retains coordinatewise support shared within each unit, accumulates only across units, and maps unmet release conditions to hold, confirm, or fallback. Under the stated assumptions, source-local values cannot identify countability; the coordinatewise meet is the greatest budget satisfying singleton fidelity and insertion non-amplification, with coarsening monotonicity and fixed-partition stability. Across 31,200 evaluations in 48 scene clusters, PACT attains a common-support normalized risk-coverage area (ncsAURC) of 0.0861. Excluding the constructed adversarial-consensus arm, provenance-partition aggregation reduces ncsAURC by 0.0557 relative to singleton aggregation, while the corroboration contrast vanishes. On complete-source records, native scores favor PACT, but a common posterior-peak score narrows its difference from nested Dirichlet and favors product fusion. Reassigning provenance over unchanged predictions moves evidence budgets as predicted. In offline human-robot collaboration, eightfold within-camera duplication leaves 720 typed responses per checkpoint unchanged; camera-grouped PACT admits 47 of 57 Qwen3-VL-32B reference-consistent candidates with no observed reference-inconsistent admission in 60 episodes. PACT separates computational from evidential multiplicity: agreement constitutes corroboration only when provenance permits separate accumulation.
summary_zh: 对于具身系统而言，预测一致性本身并不能决定证据是否应触发行动；证据的源起至关重要。对单一观测结果的重复推断会倍增一致性却未增加证据，而源局部的数值无法揭示输出结果是否具有可独立计数的源起。PACT将证据可计数性视为一种关系变量，用于保留源的融合与类型化行动准入。所提供的源划分定义了可计数单元。PACT保留每个单元内共享的坐标支撑，仅跨单元进行累积，并将未满足的释放条件映射为保持、确认或回退。在所述假设下，源局部数值无法识别可计数性；坐标交运算是满足单例保真度与插入非放大性的最大预算，并具有粗化单调性与固定划分稳定性。在48个场景簇的31,200次评估中，PACT实现了0.0861的常见支撑归一化风险覆盖面积（ncsAURC）。排除构建的对抗性共识分支后，源划分聚合相对于单例聚合将ncsAURC降低了0.0557，而印证对比差异消失。在全源记录中，原生评分倾向于PACT，但常见后验峰值评分缩小了其与嵌套狄利克雷的差异，并更有利于乘积融合。在预测不变的情况下重新分配源，证据预算按预期移动。在离线人机协作中，八倍相机内复制使得每个检查点的720个类型化响应保持不变；按相机分组的PACT在60轮试验中准入57个Qwen3-VL-32B参考一致候选中的47个，且未观察到参考不一致的准入。PACT将计算多重性与证据多重性相分离：仅当源允许独立累积时，一致性才构成印证。
tldr: PACT introduces a provenance-conserving multi-view fusion method for typed action admission in human-robot collaboration, distinguishing genuine corroboration from mere agreement by enforcing evidence countability across separate sources.
tldr_zh: PACT 提出了一种保持来源的多视角融合方法，用于人机协作中的类型化动作准入，通过强制跨独立来源的证据可计数性，区分真正的确证与单纯的共识。

title: Towards a Belief-Based World Model for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are being used as policies for autonomous decision-making and planning in many domains. Despite their strong reasoning capabilities, LLMs struggle with long-horizon tasks, especially under partial observability. World models are a promising way to enhance policy performance, both during training and inference. During inference, agents currently use world models to simulate the consequences of candidate actions before committing to an action, which can improve decision-making. However, we argue that simulation alone is an incomplete interface for decision-making under partial observability: simulation doesn't adequately capture uncertainty about the current state, which agents may need for accurate decision-making. We address this limitation with Belief-Based World Models (BB-WMs), which model and maintain a belief that LLMs can query to access information on what is known and uncertain about the current state. Before developing methods to learn accurate BB-WMs, we first ask a more fundamental question: does exposing a world model's belief directly to an LLM policy improve decision-making? Our results show that giving LLM agents access to world model beliefs improves task performance under partial observability, while remaining complementary to existing simulation-based world models. Code is released at https://github.com/skumar-ml/belief-world-models.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）正被用作多个领域中自主决策与规划的策略。尽管其推理能力强大，但LLMs在处理长周期任务时仍存在困难，尤其是在部分可观测条件下。世界模型是一种在训练和推理过程中增强策略性能的有效方法。在推理阶段，智能体当前会利用世界模型模拟候选行动的后果，再执行实际动作，从而改进决策。然而，我们认为，在部分可观测条件下，仅靠模拟并非完整的决策接口：模拟无法充分捕捉当前状态的不确定性，而这一不确定性对智能体做出准确决策至关重要。我们通过基于信念的世界模型（BB-WMs）解决了这一局限，该模型能够建模并维护一种信念状态，LLMs可通过查询该状态获取关于当前已知信息与不确定性的访问。在开发学习精确BB-WMs的方法之前，我们首先提出一个更根本的问题：将世界模型的信念直接暴露给LLM策略是否能够提升决策质量？结果表明，在部分可观测条件下，赋予LLM智能体访问世界模型信念的能力有助于提高任务性能，同时其与现有基于模拟的世界模型具有互补性。代码已发布在：https://github.com/skumar-ml/belief-world-models。
tldr: The paper introduces Belief-Based World Models (BB-WMs) that maintain a belief state for LLM agents, improving decision-making under partial observability by querying what is known versus uncertain, complementing simulation-based world models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了基于信念的世界模型（BB-WMs），为LLM智能体维护一个信念状态，通过查询已知和不确定的信息来改善部分可观测环境下的决策，并与基于模拟的世界模型互补。

title: Obstacle-Aware Autonomous Coverage and Navigation for Outdoor Robots
summary: Long-duration outdoor coverage with autonomous platforms remains challenging beyond classical planning: deployments face localization drift in open spaces, obstacles in cluttered sites, controller feasibility in turn-heavy maneuvers, and persistent autonomy with energy management. We propose a unified ROS 2 architecture for outdoor coverage that combines coverage planning, robust localization, and Nav2-based execution. A dual-antenna RTK-GNSS fused in an EKF keeps the robot pose, both position and heading, accurate across long missions; three controller-aware refinements are added to a mature coverage planner; a Behavior-Tree mission manager coordinates multi-goal execution, layered recovery, cost-aware goal management, and autonomous docking for return-to-charge. We validate the stack through simulation and real-world trials across multiple outdoor areas with varying geometries and obstacle densities. Overall, these results show that the proposed stack can reliably complete outdoor coverage missions across varied areas, sweeping 93.1% to 96.1% of the planned coverage area.
tldr: This paper presents a ROS 2 architecture for outdoor coverage navigation that integrates RTK-GNSS localization, controller-aware coverage planning, and behavior-tree-based mission management, achieving 93-96% coverage in real-world tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于户外覆盖导航的ROS 2架构，集成了RTK-GNSS定位、控制器感知的覆盖规划和行为树任务管理，在真实场景中实现了93-96%的覆盖率。

title: Integrating Traffic Noise Emission Modelling into Variable Speed Limit Control
summary:
Road traffic noise remains a major environmental challenge, yet most speed management strategies are static and do not respond to short-term variations in traffic noise emissions. Although variable speed limit (VSL) systems are widely deployed for safety and congestion mitigation, traffic noise is rarely treated as an explicit operational control objective.
  This paper proposes a noise-aware VSL framework that integrates aggregated traffic-state estimation with a simplified CNOSSOS-EU-based emission indicator. A stage-based controller with time-varying reference thresholds dynamically adjusts discrete speed-limit levels in response to estimated emission conditions. The framework is evaluated using microscopic traffic simulation calibrated with empirical motorway data and replicated across multiple stochastic realisations.
  Over a 24-hour evaluation period, the adaptive strategy reduces the receiver-based equivalent sound level by 2.9 dB(A) relative to unrestricted traffic conditions, while maintaining an average vehicle speed approximately 11.3 km/h higher than a permanently imposed low-speed regime. Period-wise analysis shows that speed reductions are activated selectively when emission levels approach calibrated targets, rather than enforcing a constant intermediate limit. Traffic stability indicators reveal moderate increases in speed variability compared with unrestricted operation, but substantially lower braking intensity than under uniform low-speed enforcement.
  These results demonstrate the feasibility of integrating environmental performance indicators into operational speed control, providing a practical complement to conventional infrastructure-based noise mitigation measures.
tldr: This paper proposes a noise-aware variable speed limit (VSL) control framework that integrates a CNOSSOS-EU-based emission indicator to dynamically adjust speed limits, reducing traffic noise by 2.9 dB(A) while maintaining higher speeds than constant low-speed enforcement.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种噪声感知的可变限速控制框架，集成了基于CNOSSOS-EU的排放指标，动态调整限速，在比恒定低速管制保持更高平均车速的同时，将交通噪声降低了2.9分贝。

title: One Print, Many Moves: Monolithic Origami-inspired Folding Actuator for Composable Soft Multi-DoF Systems
summary: Conventional soft robot actuators excel in compliance, but their uncontrolled deformations compromise accuracy and hinder scaling to multi-degree-of-freedom (DoF) systems. We introduce a MONOlithic ORIGAMI-inspired soft folding actuator design (MONORIGAMI) that establishes a design strategy based on spatially programmed stiffness anisotropy to preserve material compliance along desired folding directions while selectively restricting deformation in unwanted directions. The actuator leverages stiffness tiers based on material thickness, patterned in an origami-inspired geometry with facets and creases, converting unconstrained soft deformation into accurate, repeatable, and composable folding motions without additional reinforcements. The design is fully 3D-printable through a single-material, single-print process that requires no assembly. Each actuator serves as a scalable motion primitive, and linking and orienting multiple actuators mechanically programs multi-DoF trajectories. Using the same fundamental module, we demonstrate three 3D-printed soft multi-DoF robotic systems spanning distinct application domains: (1) a compact 4-DoF wearable haptic device for high-fidelity cutaneous feedback in virtual reality (VR), (2) a 3-DoF joystick for kinesthetic feedback in teleoperation, and (3) a modular robotic gripper capable of underwater operation with geometry-encoded grasp trajectories. These systems demonstrate the module's capabilities for compact multi-axis integration, controlled physical interaction, and geometry-programmed operation across different environments. Together, these results show that MONORIGAMI provides a general, composable, accessible, reliable, and scalable platform for high-precision soft multi-DoF robotics, addressing long-standing limitations in both soft actuator design and fabrication.
tldr: This paper introduces MONORIGAMI, a 3D-printable, origami-inspired soft folding actuator that achieves precise, repeatable motions by spatially programming stiffness anisotropy, and demonstrates its composability across multiple multi-DoF robotic systems (wearable haptics, joystick, underwater gripper).
tldr_zh: 本文提出MONORIGAMI，一种基于折纸启发、可3D打印的软体折叠驱动器，通过空间刚度各向异性实现精确可重复运动，并在多个多自由度机器人系统（可穿戴触觉、操纵杆、水下夹爪）中展示了其可组合性。

title: Inverse kinematic solution for generic 3R positional robots using Conformal Geometric Algebra
summary: The inverse kinematics of generic 3R robots has been investigated through multiple approaches, mainly algebraic methods involving the solution of certain equation sets. Previous geometric interpretations of the solution, characterized as the intersection of a pair of conics have been confined to the joint-space domain. In this article, we study the Inverse Kinematic Model (IKM) of 3R robots, using the advantages of Conformal Geometric Algebra (CGA) to provide further insights on its kinematic properties. Our approach directly yields a univariate polynomial in terms of theta_2 without the need to eliminate theta_1 and theta_3 by reframing the problem as the intersection of two circles, which are fundamental elements within this algebraic framework.
tldr: This paper presents an inverse kinematic solution for generic 3R positional robots using Conformal Geometric Algebra, reformulating the problem as the intersection of two circles to directly obtain a univariate polynomial.
tldr_zh: 本文利用共形几何代数方法求解通用3R位置机器人的逆运动学，将问题重构为两个圆的交点，从而直接得到一元多项式。

title: Vision-Language-Guided Pseudo-Labels for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Semantic Segmentation for Waste Sorting
summary: Obtaining labeled data for semantic segmentation in applied settings (e.g., autonomous driving, industrial waste sorting) is expensive and often infeasible at scale. We present a cross-modal pseudo-labeling pipeline that enables unsupervised domain adaptation without any target-domain annotations. The pipeline is built on two core foundation models: SAM generates class-agnostic region proposals, and EVA-CLIP assigns semantic labels based on region-text similarity, with confidence filtering ensuring that only reliable pseudo-labels are used for self-training a segmentation model. As an optional extension, BLIP provides language-grounded verification for ambiguous regions, thereby improving pseudo-label quality without altering the overall pipeline. Evaluated on two domain shifts, synthetic-to-real autonomous driving and, with a primary focus, lab-to-factory industrial waste sorting, the pipeline consistently improves over source-only baselines. Our results demonstrate that pseudo-label quality, not quantity, is a decisive factor in self-training under domain shift, and that cross-modal language grounding offers a practical path to reliable automatic annotation in deployment-critical applications.
tldr: This paper presents a cross-modal pseudo-labeling pipeline for unsupervised domain adaptation in semantic segmentation, targeting waste sorting and autonomous driving, using foundation models (SAM, EVA-CLIP, optionally BLIP) to generate reliable pseudo-labels without target-domain annotations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种跨模态伪标签流水线，用于语义分割中的无监督域适应，目标领域为废物分类和自动驾驶，利用基础模型（SAM、EVA-CLIP、可选的BLIP）生成可靠的伪标签，而无需目标域标注。

title: Monocular Depth Estimation from a Single Image: Progress and Opportunities
summary: Monocular depth estimation has long stood as a fundamental challenge in computer vision, enabling a wide range of applications including 3D reconstruction, robotics, autonomous driving, and augmented reality. This survey traces the field's evolution from early learning-based methods to the emergence of transformative foundation models. We begin by framing the problem, distinguishing between relative and metric depth estimation, and highlighting the key challenges that have shaped a decade of research. We then present common problem formulations and introduce the most widely used datasets, covering indoor, outdoor, and synthetic data. Following this, we review major advances prior to the foundation model era, distilling core insights from influential methods that contributed to improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and robustness. The survey then turns to the recent surge of foundation-model-based approaches, categorizing them into discriminative and generative paradigms and emphasizing the critical roles of large-scale pretraining (e.g., DINOv3) and synthetic data. We compare representative models using both quantitative benchmarks and qualitative examples, and discuss natural extensions to video-based depth estimation. Further, to illustrate real-world impact, we highlight the integration of depth estimation into applications such as visual SLAM, content generation, and robot perception. Finally, we outline open challenges and promising research directions as the field advances further into the era of foundation models.
tldr: This survey comprehensively reviews monocular depth estimation, tracing its evolution from early learning-based methods to foundation-model-based approaches, and discusses applications in robotics and autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述全面回顾了单目深度估计的发展，从早期基于学习的方法到基于基础模型的方法，并讨论了在机器人和自动驾驶中的应用。

title: SG-AMP: Scene-Graph-Guided Active Perception and Semantics-Aware Motion Planning for Pepper Plants
summary: We present SG-AMP, integrating robust depth completion with input-conditioned uncertainty, persistent panoptic mapping, plant scene-graph reasoning, and semantics-aware active view-motion planning. Beyond inspecting uncertain observed regions, the scene graph explicitly hypothesizes unobserved pepper--peduncle attachments and directs close-range sensing toward them. Candidate views are selected according to expected information gain, while class-dependent motion costs distinguish protected peppers, peduncles, and stems from conditionally traversable foliage. On pepper data, the perception network achieves $55.27\%$ semantic mIoU, $38.67\%$ PQ, and $40.62\,\mathrm{mm}$ depth RMSE, while input-conditioned uncertainty improves NYUv2 NLL from $-1.6518$ to $-1.6925$ and AUSE from $0.0102$ to $0.0087$.
tldr: SG-AMP integrates depth completion, panoptic mapping, scene-graph reasoning, and semantics-aware motion planning for active perception of pepper plants, using a scene graph to hypothesize unobserved attachments and guide view planning.
tldr_zh: SG-AMP 整合了深度补全、全景建图、场景图推理和语义感知运动规划，用于辣椒植物的主动感知，通过场景图假设未观测到的连接关系以引导视点规划。

title: Vision-Based Leader-Follower Formation Control for Cooperative UAVs in GPS-Degraded Environments
summary: Cooperation in multi-UAV systems requires reliable relative perception so that follower vehicles can maintain formation and continue their mission safely even when absolute positioning sensors degrade or fail. This paper presents a vision-based cooperative formation framework running on a follower UAV that uses a front-facing RGB-D camera to detect, track, and localize a leader UAV in real-time. A lightweight YOLO-based detector is trained on a dedicated drone dataset and deployed onboard to predict leader bounding boxes, which are then fused with depth information via a pinhole camera model to estimate the leader's relative pose. These estimates provide a leader-follower position controller and can also be used as a backup when GPS or external localization is unavailable. This framework is implemented as a set of ROS nodes and evaluated in a physics-based multi-UAV simulation built on XTDrone, with sensor noise and communication dropouts. We evaluate detection accuracy, runtime, and formation-keeping error under nominal conditions and under simulated failures of the positioning sensors. The results show that the proposed framework maintains stable leader-follower formations with reasonable computational cost and provides a practical basis for extending vision-based cooperative formation control to real-world multi-UAV systems.
tldr: This work presents a vision-based leader-follower formation control framework for multi-UAV systems using an RGB-D camera and YOLO detection, evaluated in simulation as a backup for GPS-denied environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于视觉的领导者-跟随者编队控制框架，使用RGB-D摄像头和YOLO检测，在GPS退化环境下作为备份，并在多无人机仿真中进行了评估。

title: Dual Process Motion Planning
summary: Robotic systems are deeply embedded in both industry and everyday life, where they are expected to act with speed, precision, and reliability. Classical control and planning methods have long delivered strong guarantees, but often at the cost of computational efficiency and adaptability. More recently, learning-based approaches have shown promise in overcoming these limitations, enabling agents to leverage experience to accelerate decision-making and address previously intractable problems. In this work, we bridge these two approaches through a neuro-symbolic perspective on nonlinear motion planning. Inspired by the Thinking Fast and Slow paradigm, we introduce a dual-process architecture that combines the strengths of robust reasoning and learning. Our framework integrates state-of-the-art symbolic solvers as a ``System-2'' component with experience-driven ``System-1'' modules. A metacognitive controller dynamically orchestrates their interaction, selecting when to rely on fast intuition versus slower, more precise reasoning. By evaluating the framework across diverse nonlinear benchmark environments, we demonstrate that this architecture yields consistent gains in planning efficiency, accuracy, and generalization, while promoting reuse across tasks. The results suggest that tightly coupling learning with structured reasoning offers a scalable path toward more capable and adaptive robotic systems.
tldr: The paper proposes a dual-process motion planning framework for robotics, combining symbolic solvers with learning-based modules orchestrated by a metacognitive controller to improve efficiency, accuracy, and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种双过程运动规划框架，将符号求解器与基于学习的模块结合，通过元认知控制器动态协调，以提高规划效率、准确性和泛化能力。

title: Connectivity-Aware Graph Extension for Decentralized Multi-Robot Exploration
summary: Exploring unknown environments with multiple UAVs requires coordination under intermittent communication, making decentralized operation a baseline assumption. We propose, within a decentralized framework, a novel exploration graph extension strategy based on frontier connectivity to extend exploration plans and maintain area partitioning among agents stable and robust to disconnections and changes in spatial layout. The proposed extension method is applied to two state-of-the-art area partitioning methods and evaluated in simulation. Experiments show improved performance over existing graph extension approaches with higher exploration efficiency under low communication rate.
tldr: A decentralized multi-robot exploration method using frontier connectivity to extend exploration graphs, improving stability and efficiency under low communication.
tldr_zh: 一种基于前沿连通性的去中心化多机器人探索图扩展方法，在低通信率下提高了探索效率与稳定性。

title: Fleets Need a Context Plane: Rethinking Cooperative Perception for Autonomous Drones
summary: Cooperative perception allows a drone fleet to combine observations from multiple viewpoints. However, existing systems typically fix their feature-sharing policies at design time or adapt to only one context signal. This is a poor fit for aerial fleets, whose missions, bandwidth, formation geometry, and scene coverage can change during flight. We quantify the cost of context-blind sharing on UAV3D by controlling feature exchange at evaluation time using a released DiscoNet checkpoint, without retraining. Mission-aware sharing matches full-sharing accuracy while using only 5-10% of the bytes. The best tested peer selection policy changes with the byte budget, and choosing the wrong policy loses up to 7.7 AP. Moreover, under a constrained budget, two policies with the same full-scene accuracy differ by 5.9 AP within the mission region, showing that multiple context axes must be considered jointly. We therefore propose the context plane, a bounded, structured interface for runtime context. Each drone publishes a descriptor of at most 1 KB at 10 Hz, and lightweight, replaceable policies use the fleet context to decide what each drone computes, shares, and fuses. Existing sharing schemes become fixed policies within this interface. In our ROS 2 prototype on a Jetson AGX Orin, the context plane uses approximately 0.01% of the data-plane bandwidth, and each policy decision takes 0.10 ms. These results show that an explicit context interface can support low-overhead runtime adaptation without modifying or retraining the perception model.
tldr: Proposes a context plane interface for drone fleets to dynamically adapt cooperative perception policies (e.g., feature sharing, peer selection) at runtime, achieving low overhead and significant bandwidth savings without retraining.
tldr_zh: 提出用于无人机群的上下文平面接口，使其能够在运行时动态调整协作感知策略（如特征共享、伙伴选择），在不重新训练的前提下实现低开销和显著的带宽节省。

title: Beyond Object Selection:Markerless Gaze-based Robot Placement at Arbitrary Position
summary: Gaze-based assistive manipulation typically supports object selection, while arbitrary-position placement requires accurate spatial alignment between the headset and robot. However, for gaze-based manipulation, pose accuracy does not necessarily translate into task accuracy: translational and rotational errors jointly affect the transformed gaze ray and may compensate for each other. To study cross-device alignment from this task-oriented perspective, we present a markerless interaction framework and a dedicated cross-device dataset. We propose Graph-based Reference Selection to address sparse robot references. We further develop and benchmark multiple task-specific alignment pipelines under a unified protocol. Specifically, we introduce Gaze--Surface Intersection Error (GSIE), which directly measures the spatial error of the gaze-specified target. Experiments show that alignment methods ranked highly by conventional pose metrics are not always optimal in GSIE, demonstrating the importance of evaluating gaze-based manipulation at the task level.
tldr: This paper proposes a markerless gaze-based framework for arbitrary-position robot placement, introducing the Gaze–Surface Intersection Error (GSIE) metric and showing that task-level evaluation reveals different optimal alignment methods than conventional pose metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无标记的基于目光的机器人任意位置放置框架，引入了注视-表面交点误差（GSIE）度量，并表明任务级评估揭示了与常规位姿度量不同的最优对齐方法。

title: Retrieved but not ranked: surface-form bias in structural retrieval, from mathematics to agent trajectories
summary: We evaluate embedding retrieval where surface form and meaning are pulled apart on purpose: retrieving items that share underlying structure but not wording, in two unrelated domains under one protocol, competition mathematics (MathNet-Retrieve; 500 queries, 117,088-item corpus) and embodied-agent trajectories (ALFWorld-derived; 118 queries, 336 trajectories). In mathematics the failure is complete: strict Hit@1 at the heaviest disguise tier is 0.0% for both production embedders (bootstrap 95% CI [0.0, 0.0]) while the correct item sits in the top 10 nearly always, and in 95.2 to 99.8% of misses the winner is more lexically similar to the query than the correct answer. In trajectories, where surface variation is incidental, the same models land at or near hypergeometric chance when gold must involve a different object, and below chance for all three embedders once gold must differ in object and receptacle: retrieval anchors on literal tokens, not task structure. A lexical reranker control hurts in mathematics and helps in trajectories (closing 26 to 36% of the gap, CIs excluding zero); its sign reveals whether a benchmark's surface variation is adversarial or incidental. An LLM reranker recovers 5 to 63% of the gap in mathematics and 43 to 76% in trajectories; direction replicates across three judges (all 21 cells positive), but effect sizes, tier profiles, and the outlier judge change with domain (paired differences excluding zero everywhere). Mathematics gains concentrate on well-known competitions (+19.8 points, CI [+6.7, +33.2], one of six cells), so part of the recovery is memorization. In a paired downstream experiment (210 queries, graders at 96 to 99% agreement), oracle retrieval was indistinguishable from adversarially bad retrieval (McNemar p = 0.678); the solver's 69.5% zero-shot accuracy is largely a truncation proxy (97 to 100% on finished answers), leaving no headroom.
tldr: This paper studies embedding retrieval under adversarial surface-form disguise in two domains (mathematics and agent trajectories), finding that standard embedders fail catastrophically and lexical reranking's effect varies by domain, while LLM reranking partially recovers structure-based retrieval.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在对抗性表面形式伪装下的嵌入检索问题，涵盖数学和智能体轨迹两个领域，发现标准嵌入器严重失败，词汇重排序的效果因领域而异，而LLM重排序能部分恢复基于结构的检索。

title: Provably Safe Sim-to-Real Transfer
